card.name: Linking words before a verb or noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as between, of, that, to, in and when, and some verbs, that sit just before a phrase completing the idea. Seen in both instructions and general prose.

modes.label: Linking word after a noun
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction such as of, to or that follows a noun or adjective and leads into a further phrase.
modes.example: although there is an abundance of knowledge, a lack<< of>> knowledge mobilization.

modes.label: Preposition in instructions
modes.description: A word like between or in appears where a split or placement is being described.
